assertions.title: Starbucks Pivot communicates geo-strategy portfolio surgery

steps.action: Open /projects/starbucks-pivot on the shared production-like runtime
steps.expected: The route should clearly frame suburban/office migration strategy with recommendation classes and top-level economics
steps.observed: The hero labeled the page 'Starbucks Pivot: geo-strategy operating board' and described 'office-district collapse versus suburban midday migration' while the top card surfaced recommendation classes Convert, Lockers, and Close with top-level economics including 'Portfolio delta: $2M', office exposure 71%, residential 28%, and 'DiD ATE: -18%'.

steps.action: Inspect the BLUF and trust summary near the top of the route
steps.expected: The route should pair top-level economics with causal framing and limitations
steps.observed: The BLUF asked which suburban stores should convert to pickup-only/drive-thru-only, stated that a Diff-in-Diff design estimated a traffic shift away from office-adjacent stores, and labeled the payload 'MODELED' with limitation copy that store-level profitability deltas are scenario outputs rather than reported P&Ls.

assertions.title: Starbucks controls drive visible map and causal-board updates

steps.action: Capture the baseline route state with default controls
steps.expected: The page should expose user-adjustable WFH or office-shock controls and downstream views tied to the active state
steps.observed: Baseline state exposed sliders at WFH index 58% and Office park shock 42%, visible store filter ALL, a pinned-store panel for Denver Store 01 with Recommendation Lockers, and a top queue led by Denver Store 48 at $38K projected uplift.

steps.action: Increase WFH index to 61%, reduce office park shock to 40%, and switch the visible-store filter from ALL to OFFICE
steps.expected: At least the selected-store workflow and two downstream views should update visibly without a page reload
steps.observed: Without a document reload, the sliders updated to 61% and 40%, the queue recomputed with Denver Store 48 still ranked first but now at $40K uplift, the lower queue reordered to replace Denver Store 54 with Denver Store 11 and Denver Store 14, and the route showed 'Filter: OFFICE'.

steps.action: Switch the segment filter from OFFICE to RESIDENTIAL and inspect the queue state
steps.expected: Changing segment filters should visibly drive another downstream scenario update
steps.observed: The queue and visible-state messaging changed again to 'Filter: RESIDENTIAL', the queue lead changed to Denver Store 60, and the top ranked actions switched from convert recommendations to locker-installation recommendations such as '1. Denver Store 60 ... $25K' and '2. Denver Store 55 ... $26K'.

evidence.network: GET /projects/starbucks-pivot -> 200; slider and segment-filter changes updated the route in-page without a document reload

assertions.title: Starbucks route converts scenario analysis into ranked actions

steps.action: Inspect the decision console, queue, and evidence pack in the default scenario
steps.expected: The route should expose portfolio delta, recommendation mix, top-priority store, ranked implementation logic, and supporting evidence
steps.observed: The decision console surfaced recommendation composition, the top-10 queue, and an evidence trace. In the default state it showed 'Portfolio delta: $2M', Convert 9 / Lockers 51 / Close 0, and ranked Denver Store 48 first with a $38K uplift and explanation for immediate format conversion review.

steps.action: Inspect the evidence trace after the OFFICE scenario update
steps.expected: Ranked actions should remain tied to supporting evidence under the active assumptions
steps.observed: After the OFFICE-filter scenario change, the evidence rail updated to 'Counterfactual delta: Denver Store 48 ranks #1 with $40K scenario delta' and the route kept the causal note that recommendation confidence is directional with DiD ATE -18% and a -26% to -10% interval.

steps.action: Select the top residential queue item after switching to the RESIDENTIAL filter
steps.expected: The selected-store panel and evidence should synchronize with the ranked action logic
steps.observed: Selecting the top residential action synchronized the route around Denver Store 60, showing 'Store: Denver Store 60', 'Recommendation: Lockers', 'Execution action: Install lockers', 'Projected delta: $25K', and 'Counterfactual delta: Denver Store 60 ranks #1 with $25K scenario delta'.

evidence.network: GET /projects/starbucks-pivot -> 200; decision, queue, and evidence surfaces updated in-page under active scenario and queue-selection changes

assertions.title: Starbucks trust framing keeps causal uncertainty visible near action outputs

steps.action: Inspect the trust/provenance and assumptions surfaces near the top of the route
steps.expected: The route should make modeled, scenario-specific, and auditable trust framing visible before deeper analysis
steps.observed: The route exposed 'TRUST, PROVENANCE & CURRENT RUN', current run metadata ('run real-20260219202020'), module readiness, and an appendix labeled 'Assumptions, limits & swap path', all before the deeper interactive sections.

steps.action: Inspect the causal board and decision-area copy next to recommendation outputs
steps.expected: Causal outputs should remain directional and uncertainty-aware rather than treated as guaranteed truth
steps.observed: The causal board stated 'Recommendation confidence stays directional: DiD ATE is -18% with -26% → -10% interval and pretrend p-value 0.42', while the decision console explicitly labeled 'CAUSAL CONFIDENCE NEXT TO ACTION OUTPUT' so uncertainty remained adjacent to the action queue.

assertions.title: Starbucks loading or failures preserve usable recovery

steps.expected: The loading state should be Starbucks-specific and preserve a visible recovery path
steps.observed: The loading probe rendered 'Loading Starbucks Suburban Pivot' with copy that geo layers, queue logic, and causal overlays were rehydrating while the recovery path stayed visible.

steps.expected: The route error state should preserve retry or safe return behavior
steps.observed: The error probe rendered 'Route Error Starbucks Suburban Pivot' with Starbucks-specific copy saying the controlled failure kept geo-strategy posture, causal caveats, and queue recovery actions explicit so operators could safely recover.

frictions.description: Raw body-text capture on this Next.js App Router page included streamed payload/script text, so exact visible copy was harder to isolate from text dumps alone.
frictions.resolution: Used screenshot evidence plus targeted DOM text checks and interactive snapshots to confirm the visible labels, queue items, and trust copy.

summary: Tested 5 Starbucks Pivot assertions on http://localhost:3501. All 5 passed: the route clearly framed geo-strategy portfolio surgery, scenario controls visibly recomputed queue and segment states without reload, ranked actions stayed evidence-linked and uncertainty-aware, and both supported recoverability probes exposed Starbucks-specific recovery messaging.
